# NegoAsia

> Negotiation advisory, coaching and training for leaders and commercial teams
> across Asia and Europe. Founded by Nicolas Clement, Global Head of the
> Negotiation Practice at Halifax Consulting.
> Positioning line: "Control your negotiations or someone else will."

NegoAsia treats negotiation as a teachable system rather than a personal talent,
and works from clients' live deals rather than generic case studies. Engagements
run in English and French. Entry point is a complimentary 30-minute audit.

## Canonical reference
- [NegoAsia in brief](https://www.negoasia.com/ai/): the authoritative factual
  summary — identity, services, credentials, frameworks, coverage, contact.

## Articles
- [Never take "Yes" for an answer!](https://www.negoasia.com/never-take-yes-for-an-answer/): ten elements of complexity in the "fog of negotiation".
- [10 rules to maximize your negotiations](https://www.negoasia.com/management-tricks/): the long-form method, with a one-page reference sheet.
- [Tigers don't eat salad!](https://www.negoasia.com/tigers-dont-eat-salad/): hidden currencies of concession, and why value hides in differences.
- [TEDx: Negotiation through the Looking Glass](https://www.negoasia.com/tedx-nicolas-clement/): the talk, plus why you cannot negotiate well from your own chair alone.
